name: Phase10: QA-trained copies, article-free pair-specific manipulation checks
adapter_off: All LoRA layers bypassed using PEFT disable_adapter; not an alternate model or partial multiplier.
materials_supplied: Final test: exact Phase09 question-only prompt, no article or prior answer, answer keys, reminders, hints or retries.
paired_control: Exact Phase09 prompt, prefill, per-row seed, temperature, sampling settings and320-token cap retained. Within Phase10, on/off use identical batch layouts. Historical Phase09 batch shape differs for B-E because nonparticipant rows are omitted.
isolation: Fresh per-call context and RNG stream, independent batch-row KV slot. Shared immutable base and frozen adapter weights. No conversation memory between rows or conditions.
condition_schedule: Follow the Phase09 manager and condition order, with only participating managers retained.
scoring: Source-grounded semantic grading after all calls. Full-row pass requires every requested component, without contradictory or withdrawn commitments. Actor identity and identifiable institution where requested; rank is not required.
primary_measure: Consistency with the participant-manager assigned article; original-article accuracy is separate.
secondary_measure: Consistency with the original article, reported separately.
scope: Two-article transfer across question wording after additional own-source QA training. Original Phase09 responses provide the historical comparison; no debate or verdict experiment.
off_label_meaning: On/off are new Phase10 calls. Off bypasses all LoRA layers; manager identifies the matched control row, not a separately trained base model.
execution: Model computation in JupyterLab only; local preparation, transfer, artifact authoring and inspection.
launch_gate: User authorized Phase10 with the updated QA training rule and requested the supplied comparison workbook.

token_accounting.input: Actual Mistral chat-template token IDs, including special tokens; excludes batch padding.
token_accounting.output: Actual sampled token IDs, including EOS when generated; excludes dummy tokens for finished rows.
token_accounting.delivered: Every observed response in the long-format workbook tabs and raw JSON/text logs.

checkpoint_selection: Train every manager for six epochs. Evaluate after epochs 2, 4 and 6; select the lowest token-weighted assistant-only validation NLL, then earliest epoch. Lexical screens are diagnostics only and do not affect selection or stopping. Final test unavailable to training function.

training.initialization: Exact copied existing article-trained adapter per manager; frozen shared base
training.loss: Only assistant-content tokens plus real EOS; user/template/padding tokens masked -100
training.padding: right for training, independent example attention masks
training.checkpoint_storage: Only selected checkpoint weights; all step losses, validation responses/scores and selection decisions retained
training.parallelism: Six-example gradient minibatches; independent adapter and optimizer states on one shared frozen base. Inference batches8 forA and2 for other managers. No conversation memory.
training.article03_templates: Same6-per-target and6auxiliary source-derived design, applied to Article03

validation.loss_aggregation: Cross entropy over all unmasked assistant and EOS tokens across six validation examples; token-weighted.
